The test checks if the frequency of the resulting DatetimeIndex is `None`, but currently, it seems that the frequency is not being removed as expected.

The code snippet shows that the `apply` method iterates through the range specified by `self.n` and applies the `_offset` to each element in the input. However, there is no explicit line of code that removes or sets the frequency of the resulting DatetimeIndex to `None`.

To fix this issue, you would need to add a line that explicitly sets the frequency of the resulting DatetimeIndex to `None` after all offsets have been applied.

```

```

This change will ensure that the frequency of the resulting DatetimeIndex is correctly set to `None`, as expected by the test.
